description: Source code for a trace viewer server and browser interface in the Playwright project, including server setup, trace validation, and browser automation functions.

classes.name: StdinServer
classes.description: Implements Transport interface, handles stdin data to load traces and communicate with the trace viewer.

methods.name: validateTraceUrls
methods.description: Checks if trace URLs or files exist before starting the viewer.

methods.name: startTraceViewerServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts an HTTP server for trace viewing.

methods.name: installRootRedirect
methods.description: Sets up URL redirection to the trace viewer app with parameters.

methods.name: runTraceViewerApp
methods.description: Runs the trace viewer app with specified trace URLs and browser options.

methods.name: runTraceInBrowser
methods.description: Opens trace URLs directly in a browser.

methods.name: openTraceViewerApp
methods.description: Launches the trace viewer in a browser context.

methods.name: openTraceInBrowser
methods.description: Opens a trace URL in the default browser.

methods.name: traceDescriptor
methods.description: Generates a descriptor object listing trace and resource files related to a trace name.
